trap 'echo "INTERRUPTED at $(date), cleaning up..."; kill 0; exit 1' INT TERM

OUT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/checkpoints/m2_full_qwen"
LOG_DIR="/root/runs/m2_full_qwen"
MODEL="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/models/Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B"
TRAIN_SCRIPT="/root/structfuse-context/training/train.py"

STRATEGIES=("random" "embedding_distance" "dataflow_aware")
SEEDS=(42 43 44)

mkdir -p "${LOG_DIR}" "${OUT_BASE}"

TOTAL_RUNS=9
RUN_NUM=0

for STRATEGY in "${STRATEGIES[@]}"; do
    for SEED in "${SEEDS[@]}"; do
        RUN_NUM=$((RUN_NUM + 1))
        TAG="${STRATEGY}_s${SEED}"
        LOG_FILE="${LOG_DIR}/${TAG}.log"

        echo "=========================================="
        echo "[${RUN_NUM}/${TOTAL_RUNS}] Starting: ${TAG} at $(date)"
        echo "=========================================="

        TRAIN_FILE="${DATA_DIR}/train_${STRATEGY}_s${SEED}.jsonl"
        VAL_FILE="${DATA_DIR}/val_${STRATEGY}_s${SEED}.jsonl"

        if [ ! -f "${TRAIN_FILE}" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Train file not found: ${TRAIN_FILE}"
            exit 1
        fi
        if [ ! -f "${VAL_FILE}" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Val file not found: ${VAL_FILE}"
            exit 1
        fi

        EXTRA_ARGS=""
        if [ "${STRATEGY}" = "dataflow_aware" ]; then
            EXTRA_ARGS="--dataflow-graph-file ${DATA_DIR}/dataflow_graph.json"
        fi

        python "${TRAIN_SCRIPT}" \
            --model-name "${MODEL}" \
            --train-file "${TRAIN_FILE}" \
            --val-file "${VAL_FILE}" \
            --output-dir "${OUT_DIR}" \
            --hard-negative-strategy "${STRATEGY}" \
            --learning-rate 2e-5 \
            --temperature 0.07 \
            --batch-size 8 \
            --num-epochs 2 \
            --num-negatives 7 \
            --hard-negative-ratio 0.5 \
            --use-lora \
            --gradient-checkpointing \
            --max-seq-length 2048 \
            --seed "${SEED}" \
            --eval-steps 500 \
            --save-steps 1000 \
            --wandb-project structfuse \
            --wandb-run-name "m2_full_${TAG}" \
            ${EXTRA_ARGS} \
            2>&1 | tee "${LOG_FILE}"

        TRAIN_EXIT=$?
        if [ ${TRAIN_EXIT} -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "ERROR: ${TAG} failed with exit code ${TRAIN_EXIT}"
            echo "Last 20 lines of log:"
            tail -20 "${LOG_FILE}"
            exit ${TRAIN_EXIT}

        echo "[${RUN_NUM}/${TOTAL_RUNS}] Completed: ${TAG} at $(date)"

        # Print final eval metrics from log
        grep -E "\[Final eval\]|\[eval@" "${LOG_FILE}" | tail -3

        if [ -f "${OUT_DIR}/best_by_recall_at_1/training_config.json" ]; then

        echo ""
    done

QWEN_DATA_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/full_m2_training_data"
STARCODER_DATA_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/full_m2_starcoder_data"

CHECKPOINT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/checkpoints/m2_full_starcoder"
LOG_BASE="/root/runs/m2_full_starcoder"

echo ""
echo "============================================"
echo " Phase 1: StarCoder Embedding Negatives"
echo "============================================"

mkdir -p "$STARCODER_DATA_DIR"
mkdir -p "$LOG_BASE"

cp "$QWEN_DATA_DIR/dataflow_graph.json" "$STARCODER_DATA_DIR/dataflow_graph.json"
echo "Copied dataflow_graph.json"

for seed in "${SEEDS[@]}"; do

        cp "$QWEN_DATA_DIR/train_${strategy}_s${seed}.jsonl" "$STARCODER_DATA_DIR/train_${strategy}_s${seed}.jsonl"
        cp "$QWEN_DATA_DIR/val_${strategy}_s${seed}.jsonl" "$STARCODER_DATA_DIR/val_${strategy}_s${seed}.jsonl"
        echo "Copied ${strategy}_s${seed} from Qwen"
    done
    # Copy val for embedding_distance too (val is model-independent)
    cp "$QWEN_DATA_DIR/val_embedding_distance_s${seed}.jsonl" "$STARCODER_DATA_DIR/val_embedding_distance_s${seed}.jsonl"
    echo "Copied val_embedding_distance_s${seed} from Qwen"
done

# Build StarCoder embedding negatives for each seed
for seed in "${SEEDS[@]}"; do
    echo ""

    mv "${SEED_TMPDIR}/train_embedding.jsonl" "${STARCODER_DATA_DIR}/train_embedding_distance_s${seed}.jsonl"

    # Clean up temp
    rm -rf "$SEED_TMPDIR"
done

echo "============================================"
echo " Data Validation"
echo "============================================"

EXPECTED_COUNTS="42:11308 43:11236 44:11264"

    seed="${entry%%:*}"
    expected="${entry##*:}"
    for strategy in "${STRATEGIES[@]}"; do
        file="${STARCODER_DATA_DIR}/train_${strategy}_s${seed}.jsonl"
        if [ ! -f "$file" ]; then
            echo "MISSING: $file"
            ALL_OK=false
            continue
        fi
        actual=$(wc -l < "$file")
        if [ "$actual" -ne "$expected" ]; then
            echo "COUNT MISMATCH: $file expected=$expected actual=$actual"
            ALL_OK=false
        else
            echo "OK: train_${strategy}_s${seed}.jsonl = $actual lines"
        fi
    done
done

# Check val files
for seed in "${SEEDS[@]}"; do
    for strategy in "${STRATEGIES[@]}"; do
        file="${STARCODER_DATA_DIR}/val_${strategy}_s${seed}.jsonl"
        if [ ! -f "$file" ]; then
            echo "MISSING VAL: $file"
            ALL_OK=false
        fi
    done
done

if [ "$ALL_OK" = false ]; then
    echo "DATA VALIDATION FAILED — aborting training"

echo ""
echo "Data validation passed: 9 train + 9 val files"

# ── Phase 2: Training ────────────────────────────────────────────────
echo ""
echo "============================================"
echo " Phase 2: StarCoder M2 Training (9 runs)"
echo " Start: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"

        RUN_NAME="${strategy}_s${seed}"
        OUTPUT_DIR="${CHECKPOINT_BASE}/${RUN_NAME}"
        TRAIN_FILE="${STARCODER_DATA_DIR}/train_${strategy}_s${seed}.jsonl"
        VAL_FILE="${STARCODER_DATA_DIR}/val_${strategy}_s${seed}.jsonl"
        RUN_LOG="${LOG_BASE}/${RUN_NAME}.log"

        echo ""
        echo "── Training: ${RUN_NAME} ──"
        echo "  Output: $OUTPUT_DIR"
        echo "  Log: $RUN_LOG"

        mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR" "$(dirname "$RUN_LOG")"

        EXTRA_ARGS=""

            EXTRA_ARGS="--dataflow-graph-file ${STARCODER_DATA_DIR}/dataflow_graph.json"

        python -u "${PROJECT_ROOT}/training/train.py" \

            --train-file "$TRAIN_FILE" \
            --val-file "$VAL_FILE" \
            --output-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR" \
            --hard-negative-strategy "$strategy" \

            --num-epochs 2 \

            --temperature 0.07 \
            --hard-negative-ratio 0.5 \
            --eval-steps 500 \
            --save-steps 1000 \
            --use-lora \
            --gradient-checkpointing \
            --wandb-project structfuse \
            --wandb-run-name "m2_full_sc2_${RUN_NAME}" \
            $EXTRA_ARGS \
            2>&1 | tee "$RUN_LOG"

        echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] DONE: ${RUN_NAME}"

        # Clean intermediate checkpoints if best exists
        if [ -d "${OUTPUT_DIR}/best" ]; then
            find "${OUTPUT_DIR}" -maxdepth 1 -name "checkpoint-*" -type d -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
        fi
    done
done

echo ""
echo "============================================"
echo " ALL 9 RUNS COMPLETED"
echo " End: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo "============================================"
